All 13 iter2 export tests + 11 iter4 action-mode tests + 16 iter1 base tests + 21 iter5 new tests = 61 PASSED. No console errors.

ui_bugs.issue: Carry-over from iter2/iter3 — width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings on first paint. Charts render correctly. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 47 lines — excellent reduction from 1004. Lifespan context replaces deprecated on_event. Single `await seed()` call. Clean.

models.py PlanStep discriminated union is correctly typed with Annotated + Field(discriminator='type') and ActionPlan.steps has min_length=1 + max_length=50 — verified rejecting all bad payloads at 422.

payroll_engine.run_payroll() shared helper takes audit_action param ('payroll_run' default, 'ai_payroll_run' from AI path) — both call sites produce identical doc shape (verified via /api/payroll/runs sort + key/totals comparison).
_extract_plan() now picks the LAST valid fenced JSON block (was first) — relevant when AI emits an example block + a real plan. Verified by static code review (re.findall + reversed iteration).

All routers use APIRouter with prefix; main api router applies /api prefix once. Endpoints unchanged (auth/me, employees, payroll/runs, leave, attendance, dashboard/overview, audit, compliance/summary, assistant/*).

MINOR: CORS still allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False — fine since Authorization header is used (sessionStorage Bearer token), no cookies. But if cookies are added later, must switch to explicit origins.

MINOR: routers/assistant.py _exec_step lacks a unit-level fallback after the discriminated union — in practice unreachable because Pydantic validates upfront, but a `raise ValueError` final clause is present for defense-in-depth (good).
seed_data_creation: test_iter5_refactor.py creates throwaway 50-step plan (all leave_decisions on fake IDs — runtime errors, no DB writes), one direct payroll run + one AI-driven payroll run for equivalence comparison. test_iter4_action_mode.py reuses prior fixtures (TEST_iter4 employee with comma in name+bank, pending leave, multi-step plan).
